name: Meshrin

abilities.name: Wounded Frenzy
abilities.description: While below half its hit point maximum, Meshrin has advantage on attack rolls and saving throws.

abilities.name: Hold Breath
abilities.description: Meshrin can hold its breath for 15 minutes.

abilities.name: Great Weapon Master
abilities.description: When Meshrin hits a creature with its Greataxe, the attack deals an extra 3 damage.

abilities.name: Marsh Stride
abilities.description: Difficult Terrain composed of mud doesn't cost Meshrin extra movement, and Meshrin can move across mud without needing to make an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Meshrin makes three attacks, using Greataxe or Javelin. It can replace one attack with a use of Terror Roar.

actions.name: Greataxe
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) slashing damage.

actions.name: Javelin
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) piercing damage. Immediately after the attack, its javelin returns to Meshrin's grasp, and the target's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of Meshrin's next turn.

actions.name: Terror Roar
actions.description: Each creature of Meshrin's choice in a 30-foot radius originating from Meshrin that can see or hear it must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is frightened until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the target is immune to this creature's terror for 24 hours.

generation.userConcept: Meshrin — Large lizard folk, 30 feet of movement, Wields a greataxe two-handed and a javelin for the throw. He is a barbarian who rages. Give him a frightening roar. AC 16, 120 hit points.

clauses.text: He is a barbarian who rages
